copy.heroIntro: Every look starts with a person, a moment and the feeling she wants to carry with her.
copy.ribbon: HER STORY ✦ YOUR MOMENT ✦ MADE WITH CARE ✦ A LITTLE SPARKLE ✦ HER STORY ✦ YOUR MOMENT ✦ MADE WITH CARE ✦ A LITTLE SPARKLE ✦
copy.chapterOneParagraphOne: A celebration, a new beginning, or a day you simply want to feel like yourself—what matters to you is where the design starts.
copy.chapterOneParagraphTwo: We talk through the occasion, the details you love and how you want to feel. From there, your idea begins to take shape as a custom look made around you.
copy.chapterTwoParagraphOne: We bring your inspiration into the design process, shaping the silhouette, colour and details around the person who will wear it.
copy.chapterTwoParagraphTwo: Each fitting gives us a chance to refine the feel and finish, so your custom piece feels considered, comfortable and unmistakably yours.
copy.chapterThreeParagraphOne: The right finishing touch can bring the whole look together. Explore thoughtful accessories, or tell us what would make your outfit feel complete.
copy.chapterThreeParagraphTwo: Whether you have a clear picture in mind or are still finding the words for it, there is room to make something personal.
copy.chapterThreeImageNote:
The little things
make it yours.
copy.valueOneText: Your occasion, your point of view.
copy.valueThreeText: A look that stays with you.
copy.journeyEyebrow: A CUSTOM LOOK, STEP BY STEP
copy.stepOneText: Tell us what you are celebrating and what you have in mind.
copy.stepTwoText: We talk through the silhouette, details and direction together.
copy.stepThreeText: At your fitting, we refine the look around you.
copy.stepFourText: Your finished look is ready for the story ahead.
copy.closingIntro: Start with a fitting or tell us what you would love to create.
